title: Mix: voice, music and sound effects
judge_notes: audio/mix.wav is the final mix: voice-over on top, the music bed ducked under it, sound effects only where the screenplay shows the action. Target -14 LUFS integrated, true peak at or below -1 dBTP.

questions.text: Is audio/mix.wav present and not empty?
Does the mix last the film's duration?
Is the mix at -14 LUFS with a true peak at or below -1 dBTP?
Is the voice clearly on top of the music in every line?
questions.evidence: Name any line that is buried.

questions.text: Does every sound effect match an action the screenplay shows in that second?
questions.evidence: Name each effect and its second.

questions.text: Is the mix free of any voice other than the voice-over (no vocals in the music, no model speech)?
questions.evidence: Name the second of any other voice.

questions.text: Do the music's start and end follow the screenplay's music column?
Is it clean: no clipping, pops or abrupt cuts?
questions.evidence: Name the second of any fault.

questions.text: Does each voice line sit at the time lines[] gives?
questions.evidence: Name any line that is off.
